next.reason: Class/category numeric with an operational sign carry over (§2023:15.2 GR5 adds 'no digits to the right of the decimal point'); use where an integer operand is required stays, with signed-only use stated as 'shall not be specified where an unsigned integer is required' except integer ABS (§2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR12); implementor-defined characteristics only under native arithmetic (§2023:15.4.1, §2023:A.1 92). But 1989 'An integer function may be used only in an arithmetic expression'; §2023:15.2 lead text lets it be used 'anywhere a sending data item of that class and category may be specified'. Looser.
